fact: The minister opened the national validation workshop on 7 October 2026 for the National Data Governance Strategy, a seven-pillar document with a roadmap to 2030, saying amendments from working groups go to plenary before the strategy is adopted.

UNECA reports that a national workshop in N'Djamena on 7 October 2026 reviewed and validated Chad's National Data Governance Strategy, with 50 participants; no cabinet approval or government launch is stated.

UNECA and GIZ are supporting the Ministry of Telecommunications in developing a National Data Governance Strategy, with consultations and a workshop in N'Djamena on 13-21 May 2026 (date inferred from the mission start; the page carries none).

UNECA reports that the first phase of developing Chad's National Data Governance Strategy closed with a stakeholder workshop on 21 May 2026, which discussed preliminary findings of the country assessment.
Le Pays reports that a workshop opened on 18 May 2026 to prepare the formal drafting of Chad's first National Data Governance Strategy.

The UN Economic Commission for Africa says Chad's government, through the Ministry of Telecommunications, Digital Economy and Digitalization of Administration with ECA and GIZ, is developing a National Data Governance Strategy, with consultations on 13-15 May 2026 and a stakeholder workshop on 21 May 2026 to validate findings; the page announces these engagements and carries no publication date (its published date is a proxy for their start).

The telecommunications minister opened a national validation workshop on 7 October 2026 for Chad's draft Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données, with working-group amendments to go to plenary before adoption.
